decisions.briefing: Markets rallied: NASDAQ rose 2.2% and the S&P 500 rose 1.5%, a clear risk-on day that meets our trigger for putting leftover cash to work. All seven current holdings stay in place, and stop-losses and profit targets will manage exits. The roughly $446 of cash is going into EQPT, the 95-scored name with the most room before it looks overbought. We are avoiding the many candidates with RSI above 70 because they look stretched.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose broadly today: the tech-heavy NASDAQ gained 2.2% and the S&P 500 gained 1.5%. The screener shows the gains led by semiconductor, optical-networking and AI-infrastructure stocks such as SNDK, DELL, LITE, AMD and MU, many now trading well above their 20-day averages. No news headlines were provided today, so this is based only on price and momentum data, not on a specific news catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面走高，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數上揚2.2%，標普500指數亦升1.5%。從篩選結果來看，半導體、光通訊及AI基建相關股份領漲，包括SNDK、DELL、LITE、AMD及MU等，多隻股份股價已明顯高於20日均線。由於今日未有提供相關新聞標題，以上分析僅根據價格及動能數據，並無特定消息催化劑可供引述。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, faster-growing assets like tech stocks, pushing indexes such as the NASDAQ sharply higher. Strategies that wait for these days put idle cash to work when conditions favor buying, rather than forcing trades on flat, uncertain days.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 所謂「風險偏好」（Risk-On）市況，是指投資者信心高漲，資金湧向科技股等較高風險、增長較快的資產，帶動納斯達克等指數顯著上升。採用這類策略的投資者會耐心等待此類交易日，才把閒置資金投入市場，而非在走勢平淡、方向未明時勉強入市。
